acceptance_criteria.statement: One exported deeply frozen model-class grammar defines exactly local and cloud and is used by runtime validation.
Runtime preserves request-context then pack-default then local precedence; consulted invalid values fail with stable controlled PolicyError before approval logic.
A valid explicit request class short-circuits an invalid unconsulted pack default, while undefined is documented and tested as source absence.
The complete modelPolicy JSON Schema subtree is pinned exactly against the exported runtime grammar, including the default enum, preventing drift.
One shared invalid corpus covers both sources and tests accepted values, fallback, precedence, invalid types and values, and cloud/private-data approval regressions.
Exactly the three allowed files change; npm test and git diff --check pass without dependencies, network, transfer, commit, or external changes.
